title: Four-parameter logistic dose-response curves (IC50 and EC50) — bio_dose_response
text: Fits four-parameter logistic (4PL) model $$y = \mathrm{bottom} + \frac{\mathrm{top} - \mathrm{bottom}}{1 + (\mathrm{EC50} / x)^{\mathrm{hill}}}$$ group Levenberg-Marquardt least squares, written base R. bottom always lower asymptote top upper one. negative Hill slope means response falls dose, midpoint reported IC50; positive slope gives EC50. Zero doses allowed treated true zeros. Confidence intervals EC50 IC50 computed log scale.
